headline: OJK Imposes Sanctions on 10 Capital Market Cases, Here Is the List
summary: Indonesia's financial regulator OJK disclosed 10 capital market violation cases, including share price manipulation that produced unlawful gains of Rp23.77 billion. Sanctions were imposed in each case.
why: The OJK regulates Indonesia's capital markets, and enforcement against manipulation supports investor confidence in the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
original_headline: OJK Jatuhkan Sanksi 10 Kasus Pasar Modal, Ini Daftarnya
